senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. סָכַל II)to entangle, cross.

units: <cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 48:14">Gen. XLVIII, 14</cite>) [read:] <he>מהו ש׳ אמר ר׳ יהודה ש׳ ידיו … בבכורתו וכ׳</he> (<he>אמר רבי ש׳</he>, a dittography) he (God) made Jacob’s hands bring confusion into Menasseh’s birthright.
